dataIdInfo.idAbs:
The Solid Waste Land Disposal Datalayer was compiled by the Department of Environmental Protection (MassDEP) to track the locations of land disposal of solid waste. The statewide datalayer contains the majority of facilities currently regulated under MassDEP's solid waste regulations (310 CMR 16.000 and 19.000). Land Disposal refers to an operation established in accordance with a valid site assignment for the disposal of solid waste into or on land (Landfill), or a location for disposal of solid waste from one or more sources which is not established or maintained pursuant to a valid site assignment or permit (Dumping Ground). SW_LD_POLY_DAT is a database extract which has been used to create views of the MassDEP Solid Waste Land Disposal datalayer. It includes information from the EPICS Facility Master File (FMF) and other agency databases, extracts of which can be downloaded from the MassDEP website - http://www.mass.gov/eea/agencies/massdep/recycle/solid/landfills-transfer-stations-and-compost-sites.html, under the heading "Disposal and Transfer Facilities".

Data represented here are current as of June 30, 2024.
